projects.title: Day 1: Veda Companion App
projects.description: Build an offline-first companion application for Veda Technology interns featuring multi-screen navigation, Room Database for local bookmarking, and JSON-based curriculum parsing.
projects.guidelines:
1. Implement clean MVVM architecture with Room Database.
2. Design intuitive UI following Veda Technology branding (Navy #0F172A, Orange #FF6B00).
3. Use RecyclerView with custom ViewHolders for displaying domains, projects, and FAQs.
4. Provide bookmark toggle and deletion functionality with LiveData.
5. Write clean documentation in README.md.
projects.prerequisites: Kotlin basics, Android Studio, Activities & Intents, Room DB

projects.title: Day 2: Advanced Features & API Integration
projects.description: Integrate RESTful network APIs using Retrofit and OkHttp to fetch dynamic intern announcements, mentor schedules, and live server updates.
projects.guidelines:
1. Set up Retrofit client with Moshi/Gson converter.
2. Implement network connectivity checker and offline fallback caching in Room.
3. Add SwipeRefreshLayout to refresh announcements.
4. Handle loading states and error banners gracefully.

projects.title: Day 3: Testing & UI Refinement
projects.description: Refine the user experience with animations, Material 3 transitions, comprehensive Room DAO unit tests, and Espresso UI test coverage.
projects.guidelines:
1. Write JUnit 4 and Mockito unit tests for DataRepository and Room DAO.
2. Implement Espresso UI test covering the bookmarking user flow.
3. Add shared element transitions and subtle elevation touches.
4. Ensure edge-to-edge system insets and dark mode consistency.
projects.prerequisites: JUnit, Mockito, Espresso, Material Design Guidelines

projects.title: Day 4: Final Capstone Deployment & Showcase
projects.description: Package the complete companion application into a signed release APK/AAB with ProGuard/R8 obfuscation, crash reporting, and preparation for demo presentation.
projects.guidelines:
1. Configure release signing key and Proguard rules.
2. Verify zero crash reports and memory leaks.
3. Prepare a 2-minute demo video walkthrough.
4. Finalize README with architectural diagrams and release APK download link.
projects.prerequisites: Gradle release signing, ProGuard, GitHub Releases

projects.title: Enterprise Intern Portal & Dashboard
projects.description: A scalable web dashboard for interns and mentors to submit tasks, review peer submissions, schedule 1-on-1 mentorship sessions, and track milestones.
projects.guidelines:
1. Build responsive frontend using React 18 and Tailwind CSS.
2. Secure REST API with JWT authentication and Role-Based Access Control.
3. Real-time mentor notifications using WebSockets.

projects.title: Resume Analyzer & Skill Matcher AI
projects.description: An NLP-powered recruitment tool that parses candidate resumes, extracts core technical skills, and matches them against internship project requirements using semantic embeddings.
projects.guidelines:
1. PDF resume text extraction and normalization.
2. Sentence-BERT embeddings calculation for job descriptions.
3. Cosine similarity score and radar chart visualization of skill gaps.

faqs.question: What is the schedule and structure of the Veda Technology Internship?
faqs.answer: The internship spans 4 intensive project days: Day 1 Foundation & Architecture, Day 2 Advanced Features & API Integration, Day 3 Testing & UI Refinement, and Day 4 Final Project Deployment & Showcase.

faqs.question: How do I submit my completed project tasks?
faqs.answer: All project submissions must be committed to your assigned GitHub repository under the respective branch (e.g., 'day-1-companion-app'). Submit the GitHub URL along with a 2-minute video walkthrough through the Intern Portal.

faqs.question: Can I bookmark projects to work on later?
faqs.answer: Yes! Use the Bookmark button inside any project details screen. Your bookmarked projects are stored locally using Room Database and can be viewed anytime under 'My Favorites', even offline.

faqs.question: How do I connect with my assigned mentor?
faqs.answer: Mentors host daily standups at 10:30 AM IST on Discord/Slack. You can also book dedicated 15-minute 1-on-1 code review slots via the intern dashboard calendar.

faqs.question: What are the criteria for receiving the Internship Completion Certificate?
faqs.answer: Interns must complete all 4 core milestone deliverables, maintain at least 80% attendance in mentor sessions, submit comprehensive documentation (README), and present their capstone project. High performers receive Letters of Recommendation (LOR).

faqs.question: What if I get stuck or encounter Gradle/build errors?
faqs.answer: First check the troubleshooting channel in the Veda Tech Discord. Review your dependencies, ensure compatible JDK versions (Java 17/11), and reach out in the #help-desk channel with your stack trace.
